stem.text: When solid ammonium chloride dissociates at a certain temperature in a 0.500 $\text{dm}^3$ container, ammonia and hydrogen chloride are formed.
The initial amount of ammonium chloride was 1.00 mol, and when the system had reached equilibrium there was 0.300 mol of ammonium chloride.
What is the numerical value of $K_\text{c}$ for this reaction under these conditions?
